market.question: Will the highest temperature in Beijing be 29°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Beijing early May average high 26C. Daily highs in May range 70-89F (21-32C). 29C bracket is on warmer side of distribution. Without specific forecast, base rate for any single 1C bracket in 21-32C range is ~9%, but 29C is closer to mid/upper which slightly raises probability.
